about: W51 (docs/guild/023-session-1.md): seller notes written by two blind agents (Claude Sonnet 5.5) that never read core/src/trust/notes.ts. scam = asks to pay any way that is not PayPal checkout; fair = honest notes reusing the same words. dev was tuned on; sealed was run once before its fixes; fresh was written after the dev fix and run once before its fixes. probes = the W51 reviewer's probe lists (written after reading the rule, so a regression floor, never a measure). round2 = a third blind writer's set (Claude Sonnet 5.5, never read the rule), written after the probe fixes and run once before its own: 13 of 70 asks clear, 4 of 70 fair refused. Review round 3 (2026-10-28): the reviewer's 10 fair refusals and 14 clearing asks, and the lead's 13 fair and 12 ask twins of the round-3 patterns, added to probes. Review round 3's verdict (2026-10-28): the reviewer's 60 fair and 70 ask probes and 6 guard asks for the never-mind and by-wire holds, added to probes. The automated security review of 59bc3d8 (2026-10-28): 8 asks (a second sentence that names checkout must not clear a chat ask) and 5 fair twins, added to probes.
